zh.title: 空间音频实验室
zh.description: 空间音频实验室由北京大学智能学院曲天书副教授负责，研究空间听觉、三维音频场景分析、声场记录与声音重现。课题组工作涉及麦克风阵列、Ambisonics、声源定位与分离，以及音频语言模型中的空间理解。

zh.title: 曲天书
zh.description: 曲天书是北京大学智能学院副教授，主要从事空间听觉与音频信号处理研究，研究兴趣包括虚拟声音、三维音频场景分析和多通道音频编码。

en.title: 3D Audio Lab
en.description: The 3D Audio Lab is led by Associate Professor Tianshu Qu at Peking University. We study spatial hearing, 3D audio scene analysis, sound field capture and sound reproduction. Our work includes microphone arrays, Ambisonics, source localization and separation, and spatial understanding in audio-language models.

en.title: Tianshu Qu
en.description: Tianshu Qu is an Associate Professor at the School of Intelligence Science and Technology, Peking University. He studies spatial hearing and audio signal processing, with interests in virtual sound, 3D audio scene analysis and multichannel audio coding.
